[[File:Амнуэль ПР.jpg|thumb|Pavel Amnuél]]
'''Paul Rafaelovich Amnuél''' ({{Langx|he|פול אמנואל}}; born 20 February 1944) is a Soviet and Israeli physicist and science fiction writer. He was born in [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://slav-db.slav.hokudai.ac.jp/fmi/xsl/detail3.xsl?-db=russian_writer3&-lay=Layout&-recid=36932&-find=|title=Amnuel' Pavel Rafaelovich (Амнуэль Павел Рафаэлович)|publisher=Slavic Research Center, Hokkaido University|accessdate=2011-01-12|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717171058/http://slav-db.slav.hokudai.ac.jp/fmi/xsl/detail3.xsl?-db=russian_writer3&-lay=Layout&-recid=36932&-find=|archivedate=2011-07-17|url-status=dead}}</ref> He attended [[Azerbaijan State University]] and worked at [[Shamakhi Astrophysical Observatory]] for 23 years.
;Prizes
* 2013 "Running on Waves" Prize (shortlist)<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20130704231919/http://www.audag.org/?p=1958</ref>
